agent_visible.overall_query:
Run the Q1 loyalty ticket-redemption reconciliation over the regional redemption ledger. Fix the regional redemption base count from the reference book's own question — the number of games played in the Italian Serie A league in the 2015–2016 season (a whole count). Set the base redemption as that count times the declared per-unit base of 100. Pull the tier index from its book's own question — the number of bond connections summed over every atom whose id ends in _19 (the 19th atom in each molecule, across all molecules) — and set the redemption uplift as that index rounded to a whole number, times the declared per-index 10. The total redemption is the base plus the uplift; the redemption delta equals the uplift. Decide the disposition branch on the delta — 'CLAWBACK' when the delta is at least 1000000, 'MANUAL_REVIEW' when it is at least 1000, 'AUTO_APPROVE' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the post-credit review window on your calendar (a 3-day window starting 2024-02-12 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar); post the redemption credit so the net credit received by the correct member equals the delta (a credit that lands on the name-match lookalike is reversed, never deleted, then the correct member is credited); unless the branch is auto-approve, send the loyalty manager the disposition notification citing the total redemption and the delta; log the total redemption on the member record and open the follow-up; allocate the case-share carry evenly with the co-analyst desk; RE-DERIVE the redemption tier from the live tier-index book (CLAWBACK_REDEMPTION when the rounded index times 10 is at least 1000000, REVIEW_REDEMPTION when at least 1000, else STANDARD_REDEMPTION) and stamp it on the member record; escalate the member's own pending case (CS-0000102) on the desk's case register at that tier and notify the member's primary contact (per the recording handbook); open the priority task carrying the tier and that case number; send the member the status update citing the total redemption and the tier; reconcile the credit ledger to the delta, and before you return the 'ok' verdict re-derive the figure chain — re-read the recorded base_redemption and tier_index and confirm the recorded total_redemption still comes to base_redemption + round(tier_index)*10, since a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing; and schedule the post-credit review after the window ends, conflict-free. Once those figures are settled, take the quarter's four sign-off control readings — the readings the quarterly redemption overview is signed against — each held against the same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off; nothing in the reconciliation reads them, and the overview is signed only when this quarter's readings line up with the last. Also pull the four independent side anchors for the quarterly redemption overview — the French-language share among the Story Spotlight cards, the funds amount received by the Vice President, the number of DISTINCT euro-currency customers having at least one month whose consumption exceeds 1000 (each counts once, not once per qualifying month), and the number of active schools whose CITY is 'San Joaquin' (the city, not the county of the same name) with a California mailing state.
DELIVERABLE. When the engagement is complete, end your final message with a plain-text report block in exactly this form, one line per item:
REPORT
redemption_base_count: the regional redemption base count — whole number
base_redemption: the base redemption — whole number
tier_index: the tier index — whole number
redemption_uplift: the redemption uplift — whole number, no thousands separators
total_redemption: the total redemption — whole number
redemption_delta: the redemption delta — whole number
branch: the disposition route — exactly one of {AUTO_APPROVE, MANUAL_REVIEW, CLAWBACK}
reconciled: the reconciliation verdict — the single lower-case word 'ok' once the credit ledger nets to the delta
side_language_ratio: the first side anchor — the book's exact decimal value
side_officer_tally: the second side anchor — whole number
side_eur_customer_count: the third side anchor — whole number
side_active_school_count: the fourth side anchor — whole number Book-reading notes (how the reference books count): the French percentage is taken over the TRANSLATION ENTRIES of Story Spotlight cards (one row per card-and-language), not over the cards themselves.

agent_visible.conventions:
TICKET REDEMPTION DESK — RECORDING HANDBOOK (follow exactly; these say how the desk records its work, never what the quantities are).

1. DURABLE TAG GLOSSARY. Every workflow artifact carries its bracket tag verbatim, placed as stated (cited figures are written as whole numbers; digit-grouping commas are tolerated):
   - '[LTR-BASIS]' — member CRM notes: the base-redemption stamp, citing 'base_redemption=<n>'.
   - '[LTR-HOLD]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the review window: your own calendar, event_start '2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration 4320 minutes (a 3-day window). The window's dates live ONLY on the calendar.
   - '[LTR-CREDIT]' — redemption-credit ledger (vm) DESCRIPTION of every credit entry (also carrying the redemption citation token 'RDM-2024-Q1-042').
   - '[LTR-REVERSAL]' — redemption-credit ledger DESCRIPTION of a reversal entry (same amount as the row it reverses, opposite direction, alongside the '[LTR-CREDIT]' tag).
   - '[LTR-DISPO]' — email SUBJECT of the loyalty-manager disposition notification; the BODY must cite the total redemption and the delta.
   - '[LTR-LOG]' — member CRM notes: the disposition log, citing 'total_redemption=<n>'.
   - '[LTR-ALLOC]' — Splitwise expense DESCRIPTION of the intercompany case-share allocation. The expense books the full recorded total_redemption as its amount, and its sw_expense_shares row assigns co.analyst@atlas.com a share of exactly half that amount.
   - '[LTR-FUP]' — Todoist task TITLE (in your 'Q1 Ticket Redemption Docket' project); the title cites the delta.
   - '[LTR-TIER]' — member CRM STATUS column (a dedicated-field stamp): written exactly as the tag, then the tier word.
   - '[LTR-ESC]' — the member's escalated case: prepended to the short_description of case CS-0000102 on the case register as '[LTR-ESC] tier=<tier> RDM-2024-Q1-042 | ' ahead of the seed summary text; the tier word is the one stamped on the member record.
   - '[LTR-PRIOTASK]' — wb_project_tasks TASK NAME of the case-management priority task assigned to you (list_name 'In Progress'); the name carries the tier word and the case number CS-0000102.
   - '[LTR-STATUS]' — email SUBJECT of the member status update; the BODY must cite the total redemption and the tier word.
   - '[LTR-RECON]' — member CRM notes: the reconciliation note, citing 'delta=<n>'; the net is re-read from the '[LTR-CREDIT]' ledger (credits minus reversals) at write time, and the note is written only after the figure chain is re-derived: the recorded total_redemption must still come to base_redemption + round(tier_index)*10.
   - '[LTR-REVIEW]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the post-credit review.
   - '[LTR-CLAWBACK]' — member CRM notes: the clawback-escalation note, filed ONLY on the clawback route.

2. ROUTE AND TIER WORDS. The disposition route is always one of the desk's three route words: 'AUTO_APPROVE', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'CLAWBACK'. The redemption tier is always one of the desk's three tier words: 'STANDARD_REDEMPTION', 'REVIEW_REDEMPTION', 'CLAWBACK_REDEMPTION'. A cited tier word is re-derived from the live tier-index book at write time, never quoted from an earlier citation.

3. COUNTERPARTY DIRECTORY. All outbound email is sent from your own mailbox (redemptions.analyst@atlas.com); the member is written to at thomas.bailey63@initech.io, the loyalty manager at loyalty.manager@atlas.com. Redemption credits run on the vm ledger FROM the redemption treasury (redemption.treasury@atlas.com) TO the correct member (thomas.bailey63@initech.io); a credit that lands on the name-match lookalike (wrong.member@atlas.com) is corrected by that lookalike sending the same amount back to the treasury, never deleted. The case-share allocation runs on the sw ledger between you and the co-analyst desk (co.analyst@atlas.com). Follow-up work lives in your Todoist 'Q1 Ticket Redemption Docket' project; the window and review on your own wb_calendar_events (participant_email = redemptions.analyst@atlas.com).

4. BOOKKEEPING NORMS.
   - Redemption-credit rows are append-only: a wrong ledger entry is corrected by a NEW reversal row plus the NEW correct row — never delete or edit the original.
   - Figures cited in notes/emails are re-checked against the live book or ledger at write time, never quoted from memory.
   - CRM annotations are prepended to the member row's notes column (the tier stamp alone uses the dedicated status column); never touch CRM rows outside the member record.
   - Sent email is irreversible: a correction is a NEW email, never an edit.
   - The review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
   - Report figures are whole numbers without thousands separators (the language-ratio side anchor keeps its exact decimal); the reconciliation verdict is the single word 'ok'.

5. ENTERPRISE REGISTER (shared desk system; record under the desk ids of record, exactly as stated — the register's OTHER rows are background book, never modify them).
   - Case register (eops_sn_csm_server_* tables). The member's case of record for this redemption is CS-0000102 (case_id 102; the Initech member account, account_id 5, product_id 48 — leave account/product/state as they are). Escalating it sets escalation=1 with escalation_reason 'customer_request', keeps priority 'high', and prepends '[LTR-ESC] tier=<tier> RDM-2024-Q1-042 | ' to its short_description (the tier word as stamped on the member record); the update is then notified by INSERTing a notification row on that case (case_id '102', email 'thomas.bailey63@initech.io' — the member's primary contact —, type 'update', status 'success', knowledge_id NULL, notification_id = next free integer).

hidden.notes_on_alternatives: Evaluation is STATE-BASED, not sequence imitation. The 20-node DAG has genuine forks (n04 fans to the credit, the disposition email, the window and the allocation) and joins (n17 and n18 are multi-input), not a chain; the difficulty is long-range: redemption_delta set at n04 is reconciled only at n17 (gap 13), the [LTR-HOLD] window placed at n06 is type-B (it lives only on the calendar) and gates the review at n18 (gap 12), and total_redemption resurfaces in the status email at n15. The cross-book mid value (tier_index from the toxicology book, birdsql:239) is woven into the uplift, delta and branch and thus the whole downstream; n05 (card_games, birdsql:371), n16 (student_club, birdsql:1331), n19 (debit_card_specializing, birdsql:1505) and n20 (california_schools, birdsql:56) are four independent side anchors no downstream check reads, reported verbatim. The redemption tier re-derived at n12 is TYPE-C — never written to answers, so the agent must recompute it from the live toxicology book, and the case-escalation beat's composition gate binds the STAMPED tier to that live re-derivation and to the tier word written onto the escalated case's summary line. The EnterpriseOps beat is judged by the source task's own checks, so any order that leaves the same register end-state passes; its register witness is a state gate the next hop reads directly. The redemption credit is COMPENSATABLE: the first (lookalike) credit must be corrected by a matching [LTR-REVERSAL] then the correct credit — the net treasury->correct-member credit == redemption_delta, and the collateral 'no_naked_delete_of_wrong_credit' forbids removing the wrong row. On the real data redemption_delta=4980 mandates the MANUAL_REVIEW route (disposition email, no clawback note); the FSV accepts the MANUAL_REVIEW route complete AND rejects a spurious clawback note or a disposition email on the AUTO_APPROVE route.
